_meta.spec: OVCA_Decision_Engine_Spec_v0.1 §6 task 1, extended to the clear cell, endometrioid and mucinous notes
_meta.hard_rule_3: Unreported fields are the literal string "not_reported". No estimation, no inference, no carry-over from model knowledge of the trial. Where a source reports grade 3 and grade 4 separately and never sums them, the field is "not_reported" and the split is given in notes.
_meta.coverage: Trials cited by the histotype-specific regimen records in data/regimens_occc.json, regimens_oec.json and regimens_moc.json that are not already in data/tox.json. Regimens shared with HGSC (carboplatin–paclitaxel, carboplatin–PLD, PLD, weekly paclitaxel, bevacizumab combinations, PARP inhibitors, T-DXd, KEYNOTE-B96, ROSELLA) keep their HGSC tox_ref: the toxicity of a regimen is read from the trial that reported it, whatever the histology mix. Germ cell and sex cord–stromal entries (2026-10-05) are taken from the Toxicity / notes cells of OVCA_GermCell_Algorithm_v1.1 and OVCA_SexCordStromal_Algorithm_v1.0, which the notes verified against the full texts; any-cause G≥3 is not_reported unless the cell prints it.
_meta.field_conventions: As data/tox.json. grade3plus_any_pct is the ANY-CAUSE grade ≥3 rate per arm where printed; treatment_related_grade3plus_pct carries a TRAE-only figure.

table_histotype_trials.regimen: irinotecan 60 D1,8,15 + cisplatin 60 D1 q4w ×6 (CPT-P) vs paclitaxel 175 + carboplatin AUC 6 q3w ×6 (TC)
signature_ae: TC: G3/4 neutropenia 90.2%, thrombocytopenia 14.2%, sensory neuropathy 7.4%, arthralgia/myalgia
CPT-P: G3/4 diarrhoea 7.8%, nausea 10.0%, vomiting 7.8%, anorexia 7.2%, febrile neutropenia 6.9%
table_histotype_trials.discontinuation_pct: stopped chemotherapy early: TC 26% (86/325), CPT-P 28% (92/321); completed 6 cycles 73.5% vs 71.3%
table_histotype_trials.source: GO_summaries/2016_Sugiyama_Journal of Clinical Oncology.md
table_histotype_trials.notes: No treatment-related deaths. Per-AE grade 3/4 rates printed per arm; the paper never sums to an any-grade-≥3 figure, so grade3plus_any_pct stays not_reported. Asterisked AEs differed between arms at P<.05.
